Method of Attack: Hijacking 404 error pages of online retailer websites to hide malicious card-skimming code
Concealing code in HTML image tag's 'onerror' attribute
Embedding skimmer code in image binary to mimic Meta Pixel code snippet
Displaying fake payment forms to steal credit card information
Exfiltrating stolen data via base64-encoded image request URLs
Impacted Systems: online retailer websites in food and retail sectors
Attack Vector: Manipulation of default 404 Not Found error pages on compromised websites
Use of first-party relative paths triggering 404 errors to load skimmer code
Injection of malicious JavaScript skimmer code hidden in base64-encoded comments within 404 pages
Indicators of Compromise: Modified 404 error pages containing base64-encoded JavaScript skimmer in HTML comments
Fake payment forms requesting credit card number, expiration date, and security code
Base64-encoded data sent via image request URLs as query parameters
